await (async(page)=>{
const p=await page.context().newPage(),out=[];const clean=s=>s.replace(/[\w.+-]+@[\w.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/g,'[email redacted]').replace(/\+994[\d ()-]{8,18}/g,'[phone redacted]').replace(/ (?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3} /g,'[IP redacted]');
for(const path of ['/team/settings/managers','/team/invitations','/team/badges','/account/profile','/account/security','/account/notifications','/account/sessions']){
try{await p.goto('https://aevic-demo.netlify.app'+path,{waitUntil:'domcontentloaded'});await p.waitForLoadState('networkidle',{timeout:12000}).catch(()=>{});await p.waitForFunction(()=>{const s=document.querySelector('main')?.innerText||'';return s.length>120&&!s.includes('Komanda iş sahəsi hazırlanır')&&!s.includes('Sessiya yoxlanılır')},{},{timeout:12000}).catch(()=>{});out.push({path,url:p.url(),text:clean(await p.locator('main').innerText()).slice(0,7000),controls:await p.locator('main button,main select').evaluateAll(es=>es.map(e=>({text:e.textContent,type:e.type,disabled:e.disabled}))) });}catch(e){out.push({path,error:String(e)})}}
await p.close();return out;
})(page);
